source_family.input: arbitrary 3-CNF Phi on optional Boolean variables y_1,...,y_n
source_family.graph: Huang G_{C7,I(Phi)} with one distinguished positive anchor clause (x2,x1,x3) plus one C7 clause gadget for each clause of Phi using the corresponding positive/negative optional literal
source_family.P7: source-bound to Huang's theorem for the C7 construction

authoritative_seed_overlay.reason: Every Y vertex meeting residual C-type Y0 is U-type with source list {2,3,4}; optional X/~X/D vertices have source list {1,2}.

arbitrary_polarity_coexistence.statement: Literal sign does not alter the source-state class: a C-type clause vertex remains residual Y0 whether attached to x_i or ~x_i, because both optional literal vertices are outside the frozen seed and both have the same binary source/exact palette.
arbitrary_polarity_coexistence.all_eight_local_patterns: All 2^3 polarity patterns may coexist in one authoritative canonical state on the same three optional variables.

permanent_binary_pair_state.opposition: x_i and ~x_i are adjacent, so every proper coloring gives color(~x_i)=3-color(x_i)

exact_clause_semantics.signed_clause: therefore each arbitrary signed Huang clause gadget realizes exactly the corresponding 3-literal Boolean clause over the shared equality variables e_i

global_exact_embedding.forward: Any graph extension induces equality bits e_i satisfying every Boolean clause of Phi by the exact local C7 relation.
global_exact_embedding.reverse: Given any satisfying Boolean assignment e of Phi, choose independently a binary pair state (x_i,d_i) with equality bit e_i, set ~x_i to the opposite binary color, and use the stored/finite local C7 witness for every satisfied signed clause. Add the fixed seed/X0 colors.
global_exact_embedding.equivalence: authoritative signed-Huang source state has an extension iff Phi is satisfiable

QALL.connected: YES for every nonempty Phi under this construction
QALL.reason: U-type vertices are complete to all live X/D vertices; every residual C carrier attaches to its literal/D boundary and its clause-U neighbors.

restriction_audit.P7: does not remove mixed polarity because Huang's theorem already covers arbitrary formula occurrences
restriction_audit.B0: does not restrict polarity; B0 competing-survivor channel is vacuous
restriction_audit.reconstruction: local C7 reconstruction remains independent once pair states are fixed
restriction_audit.global_renamability: NOT_FORCED; arbitrary Phi may contain the same equality variable with both polarities

audit_verdict.label: PASS_NO_ADDITIONAL_SOURCE_RESTRICTION__PVNP_SCALE_CARRIER_FRONTIER
audit_verdict.meaning: The authoritative source class itself realizes unrestricted signed 3-clause composition on shared equality bits. No source-validity/P7/B0/reconstruction restriction collapses it to the renamable C10 subcase.

firewalls: This does not prove that a polynomial carrier is impossible.
It proves that a universal polynomial exact carrier for this unrestricted source family would solve arbitrary 3-SAT and hence imply P=NP.
No recursive general R1/R2 is authorized.
